blocks.content: In implicit type conversion, the type changes automatically. There is no special syntax for this type of conversion.

blocks.content: Here, the double value 45.4567 was automatically converted to an int value 45. This automatic conversion between data types is known as implicit type conversion.
In the next lesson, we'll learn how to control type conversion explicitly to make conversions more intentional.
